nodeModel.description: Every node carries :ForgedNode + :golden plus a role label and native standard labels (e.g. CedsProperty, SifField, LifProperty). Nodes are distinguished by the 'role' property and the '_source' property. More standards will be added over time; never hardcode the inventory.

relationships.description: Authored cross-standard mapping: source :ForgedNode -> :HubReference (the canonical CEDS tuple). Deterministic. Props: confidence (1.0), predicate ('exactMatch'), provenanceTier, mappingJustification, owner.

Inferred cross-standard mapping: source :ForgedNode -> :HubReference. Props: confidence (0-1), predicate ('closeMatch'), rerankScore, cosineScore, provenanceTier, mappingJustification, owner. A scored hypothesis. Two elements are equivalent when they resolve to the same HubReference.
HubReference -> its CEDS property leaf (a :CedsProperty / role DmeProperty node).
HubReference -> its CEDS range (datatype or option set).
HubReference -> its CEDS option value leaf (for enumerated tuples).
HubReference -> a co-occurring CEDS qualifier value that distinguishes the tuple.
